events.title: Pack the room! Tell Reno City Council: NO ALPRs in Reno!

location.venue: City Council Chamber at City Hall

events.description:
Your voice and your presence is needed! **Help us pack the room** at Reno City Council and defend the 4th Amendment on Wednesday, October 21, where Councilors will consider approval of a new $21 million contract for automated license plate readers (ALPRs) and other surveillance technology with Axon Enterprise. This vote is happening less than a week after City Council announced the cancellation of their Flock Safety contract and there has been **zero** public engagement on the issue. Demand Reno City Council **not** enter into any new contracts with ALPR companies and instead **ban** this deeply invasive surveillance technology in our City.

Join members of BLAG, Northern Nevada DSA, and CodePink Reno in giving public comment at Reno City Council at 10am. **The Axon contract is Agenda Item C.1.** You do not have to live in Reno to give public comment - anytime you drive through Reno, you are impacted by the City's ALPR technology. Agenda: https://reno.primegov.com/public/portal#docaccess-f731f0f82f2d017e354970e1f70c08b0

**Example talking points:** https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vSOhBL1RRCq2jF16TXtRArA8CQPyjZ4VmIV7Dip-J9tAzzCWe8LRVwPj9PrRAcZ2056eJVnTLOqc6Hl/pub

**To give public comment in person** on Wednesday, October 21, arrive by 10am and check in with the City Clerk. When called, you have 3 minutes to give your comment.

**To give public comment virtually via Zoom**, click the zoom link in the agenda for the 21st, and raise your hand during the meeting: https://links.reno.gov/Council10-21

**To give public comment by phone**, dial 1-669-444-9171, entering the Webinar ID: 889 6652 2813, and pressing #. Press *9 to “Raise Hand” and Press *6 to mute/unmute.

**To give public comment by email**, send to PublicComment@Reno.gov by 4pm the day before on Tuesday, October 20. Include "Public Comment City Council" in the subject line.

**To give public comment via the City's online form**, go here: https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=xlkxwGzVDEmnk2n5inJm5kcxAZyX3AVCp1xbE9fWt_VURVY3VTM5UEhWTkFOOFpIVERVWDRFOFZONiQlQCN0PWcu

**More Info on ALPRs:**
ALPRs are AI surveillance technology owned by billion-dollar companies. They are touted as being essential to improving public safety and solving crimes, despite there being no evidence to support these claims. What ALPRs do is capture and track the everyday movements of ordinary citizens, 24/7, by identifying your license plate, vehicle information, decals, stickers, dings and scratches. This data is uploaded to a privately-controlled national database where it is stored, analyzed by AI, and is searchable without a warrant by all levels of law enforcement. ALPRs have been used by ICE to hunt and kidnap our neighbors; they have been used by cops to track women seeking abortion; they have been used by federal and local law enforcement to stalk women and harass people they disagree with. 

These cameras do not belong in our community or in a free society. The technology is ripe for abuse and error-prone, opening the City up to lawsuits. A federal judge recently ruled the search of an ALPR database unconstitutional.

events.title: Beacon Shine the Light Thursdays Great Neck
events.description:
Join The Beacon for Thursday Shine the Light, as we bring our voices to the street every Thursday from 12:00-12:30 PM.  (NOTE NEW EARLIER TIME!)

Each week, we make our voices heard wherever we are. As beacons, we shine light by making a sign and bringing it outside. Don't have a sign? Don't worry! You can borrow one of ours.

Together, we are building visible resistance and organized compassion, meeting our neighbors, and joining together in acts of solidarity. We find joy in resistance through community, music, comedy and street theater.

Across the country, communities are organizing to disentangle local law enforcement from federal immigration enforcement. Here in Nassau County, families continue to live in terror of separation, detainment, detention and deportation.

We stand weekly in opposition to this unprecedented assault on the rights, safety, and economic security of people in this country. For 30 minutes every Thursday, we say ICE OUT OF OUR COMMUNITIES! ICE OUT FOR GOOD! and we stand in favor of compassionate democracy and against cruelty, fear and despair.

People that come together in solidarity and say NO to ICE are a critical bulwark against mass deportations and the erosion of civil rights. There is much that we can do locally. And there is much that our elected officials can do — if we demand courage and leadership. Join us!

There are Beacon groups all over the USA. Our local Great Neck group meets every Thursday from 6:00-6:30 pm. We are joined by the Singing Resistance Great Neck to sing songs of solidarity and resistance, old and new.

For more information on The Beacon, visit www.beaconfordemocracy.org

A core principle behind all ICE Out For Good events is a commitment to nonviolent action and no civil disobedience. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values, and to act lawfully at these events. Weapons of any kind, including those legally permitted, should not be brought to events. All events should be held in public spaces or on public property.

events.title: 10/19 - Voter Mobilization @ Texas State with Gina Hinojosa

address_lines: This event’s address is private. Sign up for more details
location.venue: This event’s address is private. Sign up for more details

events.description:
### Ready to do the work that actually works?

In 2024, our face-to-face voter registration model achieved a massive 79% voter turnout among the Texans we registered. We aren't just hoping for change—we have the blueprint to create it.

Join us and special guest **Gina Hinojosa** at **Texas State**! We are showing up to talk to students, spark personal conversations, and build lasting progressive power through relational organizing.

At this event, we will: 

- Engage directly with existing and potential student voters
- Connect with voters using **Reach**, our relational organizing tool, so we can personally stay in touch with them all the way to Election Day

### Shift Schedule & Flow

To ensure a smooth and high-impact day, we ask all volunteers to arrive **60 minutes before Hinojosa arrives** for our team huddle. Here is what to expect during your shift:

- **[11am-12pm]: Setup & Team Huddle** | Arrive early to grab your materials, meet the team, and align on our goals before the crowd gathers.

- **[12pm-1:30pm] Voter Mobilization** | The main event! We hit the campus ground running and get folks set up on Reach (plus a special appearance by Hinojosa!)

- **[1:30pm-2pm]: Takedown & Post-Event Debrief** | We will pack up our gear and encourage students to go vote early on campus! *Voting center can be found at the LBJ Student Center.

### How to Prepare

Before you arrive, please make sure you attend our **[mandatory online volunteer training](https://www.mobilize.us/poweredxpeople/event/908390/)** on Zoom. This training will get you fully up to speed on the flow of our events and teach you exactly how to navigate the Reach app.

### Where to Meet & Park

- **Volunteer Parking**: The [LBJ Student Center Parking Garage](https://share.google/MqhbPXFKhcjO3N0MX) is the best place for visitors to park. Don't forget to pay downstairs before you leave!

- **Meeting Location **: Upper Bobcat Trail outside [Joann Cole Mitte (JCM)] Building (https://maps.app.goo.gl/jdwwzkXn4RViBvhq6).

### What to Bring

To set yourself up for a successful shift, please bring the following items:

- Your fully charged smartphone with the Reach app already installed

- A water bottle to stay hydrated

- Comfortable shoes

Early voting is here! Lets keep up the momentum and make sure every student votes this election. Sign up for a shift today!

events.title: Celebrate Vote Early Day with Indivisible CenTex!

address_lines: This event’s address is private. Sign up for more details
location.venue: This event’s address is private. Sign up for more details

events.description:
Celebrate Vote Early Day with Indivisible CenTex!

🗓️Saturday, October 24, 2026 | Killeen, Texas

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗜𝘀 𝗩𝗼𝘁𝗲 𝗘𝗮𝗿𝗹𝘆 𝗗𝗮𝘆?
Vote Early Day (https://www.voteearlyday.org) is a national, nonpartisan civic holiday dedicated to helping Americans understand their voting options and make a plan to cast their ballots early.

Celebrated on October 24, Vote Early Day brings together organizations, businesses, community leaders, and volunteers across the country to provide voters with the information and resources they need to participate in elections.

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗜𝘀 𝗩𝗼𝘁𝗲 𝗘𝗮𝗿𝗹𝘆 𝗗𝗮𝘆 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁?
Voting is one of the most important ways people can participate in our democracy, but many eligible voters face barriers that prevent them from casting a ballot.

One of those barriers is simply a lack of information. Some voters are unsure when elections take place, where they can vote, what identification they need, or which candidates and propositions will appear on their ballots.

Vote Early Day helps address these barriers by making election information more accessible. Early voting also provides greater flexibility for people balancing work, family, transportation, and other responsibilities.

𝙊𝙪𝙧 𝙜𝙤𝙖𝙡 𝙞𝙨 𝙨𝙞𝙢𝙥𝙡𝙚: Make sure voters have the information they need to participate in our democracy.

🥳 𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗖𝗲𝗻𝗧𝗲𝘅 𝗜𝘀 𝗖𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗯𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴:
Indivisible CenTex is a grassroots, community-driven organization working to build an inclusive, informed, and engaged Central Texas community.

This year, we're celebrating Vote Early Day by taking election information directly to voters!

Over a 35-day period, our volunteers will distribute nonpartisan election information throughout Bell County, Texas, focusing on neighborhoods and apartment communities with historically low voter turnout.

Our largest volunteer effort will be THIS ONE, taking place on 𝙎𝙖𝙩𝙪𝙧𝙙𝙖𝙮, 𝙊𝙘𝙩𝙤𝙗𝙚𝙧 24, 𝙉𝙖𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣𝙖𝙡 𝙑𝙤𝙩𝙚 𝙀𝙖𝙧𝙡𝙮 𝘿𝙖𝙮!

Volunteers will deliver election information goodie bags directly to residents' doorsteps. Each bag will include helpful voting resources, such as:


✔️Election dates and voting hours

✔️List of acceptable forms of voter identification

✔️Early voting and Election Day locations

✔️Candidates appearing on the ballot

✔️Local city propositions

✔️Voting precinct information

✔️Fun stickers


Our focus is on reaching infrequent voters and communities where access to clear, reliable election information may be limited. We know that a lack of information can be a barrier to voting, and we're working to close that gap, one doorstep at a time.

⏰This will take place from 10:00–11:00 AM. 

📍Location: Killeen, Texas (exact location shared after RSVP)

🤩 𝗔𝗹𝗹 𝘃𝗼𝗹𝘂𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗲𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗼𝘄𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝘀𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗲𝘀 𝗹𝗮𝘀𝘁:

✔️Free T-shirt

✔️Free canvassing bag

✔️Snacks and drinks

✔️And MORE…


Whether you're a longtime volunteer or joining us for the first time, we'd love to have you participate in this community effort.


📸 Photography notice: Photos may be taken during the event and shared publicly. By RSVPing, you consent to event photography and the sharing of those photos.

**Help us make voting information accessible to more Central Texans. Join Indivisible CenTex on October 24 and be part of this community-wide effort!**

events.title: Community Outreach: Connect with Texans in Houston at Buffalo Bayou Mural Festival
events.description:
Skip the doorbell. We’re taking the conversation to where people already gather: at the market, on campus, outside the big event. We’re testing a new way to reach people there, and we want you to help us do it. Too often, outreach finds the same folks over and over while plenty of neighbors never hear from anyone. Community outreach is about changing that.

We’ll meet up, do a quick training, and then head to a busy spot nearby to chat with people passing through. You’ll invite them to learn more about RALLY TX, a paid community engagement program, and sign up right then on their phones with a quick QR code scan.

No experience is necessary. We’ll provide a training, a script, a clipboard, and everything else you need. Conversations are short, friendly, and easy to learn.

Come ready to meet some neighbors, try something new, and share what you saw and heard afterward so we can make the program better.

Come write postcards that make a difference! We're teaming up with Blue Wave Postcards for an afternoon of community, snacks, and civic action.

Pre-sorted postcards and voter lists ready to go

events.title: Let's Write Letters to Voters!
events.description:
Make Friends, Grab a Beer, Support Democracy!

All you need to do is show up. We'll have pre-printed letter templates with election information ready to send to voters in Wisconsin, Michigan, Iowa, Pennsylvania, and Texas. Volunteers are needed to add a personal message on each letter, and then address and stamp the envelopes so they're ready to send. It's easy, relaxing, and a great way to make an impact on this year's elections. 

**What's at stake**: 

- On November 3rd, nationwide midterm elections will decide whether Democrats retake control of the U.S. House and Senate, putting a critical check on the Trump administration. Competitive races in the midwest and across the country depend on voters turning out to vote for Democrats. 

- Our letters will go to likely Democratic voters and newly registered voters, reminding them to cast a ballot and, in some cases, encouraging them to vote for a specific Democratic candidate. 

**About Vote Forward**: 

- Vote Forward pioneered the use of handwritten letters as an effective voter turnout tactic—writing more than 40 million letters to voters with the help of more than 285,000 volunteers.

- Every cycle, Vote Forward rigorously measures the effectiveness of our voter turnout and civic engagement programs, and shares those learnings publicly.

- Learn more at votefwd.org.

location.venue: We'll be on the sidewalk not far from the HV Library Vote Center/Drop Box

events.description:
We'll be NEAR the Happy Valley Library Vote Center to encourage people to get replacement ballots if they need them and get their ballots TURNED IN BY 8PM TONIGHT!

Voting in numbers too big to ignore will discourage those that want to deny our (WE THE PEOPLEs) voices. We also need to encourage every eligible voter to sign up for TRACK YOUR BALLOT so they can cure their ballots if their signatures don't match.

A core principle behind all Indivisible events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values and to act lawfully at these events. Jen and Kip may be delayed by Marathon road closures, but they will be there!_

events.description:
Join us at this Day of the Dead Action to call in our ancestors and honor the people whose lives ended as a result of ICE detention as well as people killed by ICE and Border Patrol agents. We will have art, song, poetry and communal space. 

People are dying in detention at a record rate and ICE agents are tearing families apart, making people less safe, and causing chaos wherever they go. No one is safe when ICE is present. 

Join AFSC, Shut Down GEO and Regis University students to take action as we honor, remember, and grieve beloved family members, friends, and neighbors outside ICE's for-profit detention center in Aurora, run by GEO Group, Inc. 

This event is part of the End the ICE Age Campaign, led by Detention Watch Network, in partnership with Disappeared in America, a project of the Not Above the Law Coalition.  National partners include Detention Watch Network, NDLON, Maremoto, Public Citizen, the Workers Circle, Popular Democracy, AFSC and more.

A core principle behind this event is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation at the event. 

Please leave weapons of any kind, including those legally permitted, behind!

events.description:
Want to support organizers across NYC to run powerful art builds? Looking for a creative way to get involved with social movement work? Want to learn more about Many Hands Workshop?

Come to our November co-host training at our space in Chelsea! 

Our co-host training is Many Hands Workshop 101 - a place to build our faciliation skills, get familiar with the workshop, and dig in deep together about why art is essential to beating fascism. 

Together we'll...

- Level up our art facilitator skills 

- Learn how to welcome new people into Many Hands Workshop and plug them into art builds and organizing

- Practice teaching skills like stenciling, heat press, and painting banners and signs

- Talk about the role of community-based art making in fighting fascism

- Go over some of the basic FAQs of the workshop, like “Where is the bathroom?” and “How do I clean my paint brush?”

If you’ve ever come to an art build at Many Hands Workshop and wanted to get more involved, becoming a co-host is one of the best ways to do that. After the training, you will be invited to use your co-hosting skills at one of our upcoming public art builds.

Even if you’ve volunteered to be a co-host at a past art build, we still encourage you to go through the Co-Host Training. This training will be slightly different from the host orientations that happen before art builds. The MHW core team is working on building a standardized baseline of things every co-host should know. This co-host training is where we’ll go over that baseline information and all get synced up!

We unite to get ICE out of our communities. Close ICE concentration camps. No more ICE funding while people lose health care and struggle to afford housing, gas, and groceries. *This event, sponsored by Good Trouble Trumbull, is part of a Day of the Dead National Action by Disappeared in America.*

We welcome signs, flowers, writings, drawings, paintings, flowers, decorations, crafts, photographs, or other artistic expressions for a physical Day of the Dead tribute we’ll create together in the spirit of remembrance and peace.

events.title: 24th Annual ReLeafing Day at Big Picture High School!
events.description:
Join the Nashville Tree Foundation for our 24th Annual ReLeafing Day!

Held each year on the Saturday before Thanksgiving, ReLeafing Day is our signature community tree-planting event. Following the devastating 1998 tornadoes, our founders launched this initiative as a major restoration effort - raising $1,000,000 in six months and planting over 6,000 trees across the city. Today, that legacy continues as we focus on planting new trees in Nashville every November.

This year, we invite you to plant trees at Big Picture High School on Saturday, November 21st! We are proud to be supported by Metro Water Services.

Whether you are an experienced tree planter or a first-time volunteer, this is the perfect way to connect with nature, meet fellow tree lovers, and actively grow our urban forest!

What to Expect: 
We will start the morning with a brief introduction and an overview of the day's goals. Our team will provide a step-by-step tree planting demonstration and review essential safety guidelines so you feel completely confident. Then, we'll plant our trees!

We’ll gather with fellow students, professors, community members, and allies, with speakers sharing their testimony about how unregulated AI has impacted our lives, jobs, communities, and futures – and we’ll call for an immediate freeze on AI development now. Because we the people deserve a **life without fear of surveillance, and a chance at a future! AI is coming for our jobs, our freedoms, our planet!** And we need to determine the future of this dangerous, powerful technology – not leave it to a handful of Big Tech CEOs.

Bring your signs and your friends!
Be the change you wish to see in the world!

THINK WIDE OPEN

events.title: Join the RAZE Democracy Defense Team!
events.description:
📅 Dates: Thursday, October 22 · Thursday, October 29 · Thursday, November 5, 2026 
⏰ Time: 6pm-7pm MST
📍 Location: Zoom (link sent after you sign up)

🔥 We are ramping up to DEFEND DEMOCRACY and we need YOU! 🔥

We've spent the last two years building power across rural Arizona. We've trained volunteers in organizing skills, registered voters, knocked doors, and shown up for our communities. Now it's time to answer the call! Sign up once and you're in for all three of our Democracy Defense Mass Calls.

Why This Work Matters: Our vote is our voice, and no one gets to take it from us. Every eligible voter deserves to cast their ballot, and every valid ballot deserves to be counted. The fight doesn't end when the polls close. It goes all the way through certification, and we're going to be there every step of the way! When our communities show up together, organized and ready, we WIN. 💪

What's Involved: Three calls. One team. Everyone ready.
🗣️ Call 1, "Meeting the Moment" (Oct 22): Kick things off with Election Protection volunteers and Democracy Defense Teams from Cochise, Pinal, and Yuma. Learn the plan and claim your spot on your county team!
🛡️ Call 2, "De-escalation + Scenarios" (Oct 29): Get trained and ready for anything. Walk through real Election Day situations, learn exactly what your role is, and find out how our Response Team activates Democracy Defense Teams when it counts.
🏛️ Call 3, "After-Election Plan" (Nov 5): Come together after the election, then get ready to PACK THE ROOM at Board of Supervisors meetings and demand they certify the results, as is their duty to us, their constituents!

Missed a call? No problem! Sign up anyway and we'll send you the recording so you can jump right in. 🙌

Faith leaders, nonprofit leaders, club presidents: bring your people! This is a moment for all of us.

✨This is nonpartisan, lawful, and peaceful work. Every eligible voter. Every valid ballot. Every county certifies.

* **Monday, October 26 – Friday, October 30, 2026**

  * At-Home Phone Banking (Bring your own device): 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM

  * At-Home Phone Banking (Bring your own device): 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM

In the leadup to the November 2026 election, MICAH’s Education Taskforce is organizing congregations to engage voters for the health of our education system. Specifically, we are calling on the congregations surrounding Keefe Ave, Siefert, Clarke St, Auer Ave, Hopkins Lloyd and Douglas schools, which are at risk of closure for the 2027-2028 school year, to join our Education Hubs.

The Democracy Collective, which includes the Education Hubs, is designed to strengthen congregations’ ability to educate and activate voters while creating deeper relationships, inside and out of the congregation. events.title: Knock on doors with Ground Truth in Littleton, NH!
events.description:
Join Swing Left for a Ground Truth canvass—designed to help Democrats flip Congress in 2026, and rebuild trust for the long term. For this year, we launched an [innovative new program](https://swingleft.org/ground-truth) that will revolutionize how we connect with voters and potential voters at their doors.

At this canvass, we’ll:

- **Listen deeply** to voters’ concerns, regardless of party affiliation.

- **Persuade voters** using a data-proven approach of exchanging personal stories and making the case for how electing Democrats connects to what they care most about.

- **Gather actionable insights** for campaigns, so they can be responsive to voters’ needs and smarter with their messaging, targeting, and outreach.

Don’t worry if it’s your first time canvassing—training, materials, and support are all provided. Just bring comfortable shoes, a charged phone, and your passion for making a difference.

––

**About the program**

This isn’t traditional canvassing—it’s a whole new way of talking to voters. Together, we’ll gather authentic insights from communities, use cutting-edge tools to capture what we hear, and share it back with campaigns to strengthen their efforts.

- *Why we started early:* We launched a year ahead of the midterms to build power before campaigns were even off the ground.

- *How we’ll go big:* We’re going to a wide range of voters’ doors—not just likely Democrats—so every conversation starts to build a more complete picture of the electorate.

- *How we’ll go deep:* Canvassers practice empathetic listening and have real conversations that uncover voters’ “ground truth,” not just checking boxes on a script.

Paid for by Swing Left, Swingleft.org, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee.

events.title: Parents of Students with Disabilities: Get Out the Vote Together
events.description:
Our kids can’t afford for us to sit this election out.

As parents and caregivers of students with disabilities, we know how much is at stake when it comes to public education. Our children deserve schools that have the resources, staff, and support they need to thrive. The people we elect help shape that future.

Join fellow parents and caregivers of students with disabilities for a virtual Get Out the Vote (GOTV) text bank! We’ll come together as a community to send personal texts to our friends and family, encourage them to vote, and help make sure they know which pro-public education candidates are on their ballots.

You don’t need to be a political expert or an experienced organizer. Just bring your phone, your people, and your passion for our kids. We’ll provide the tools and support you need to make a difference.

We spend so much time advocating for our children in IEP meetings, at school board meetings, and in our communities. Now, let’s bring that same energy to the ballot box.

Our kids deserve champions. Our schools deserve support. And our voices matter.

Let’s show up for each other, for our kids, and for the future of public education. Every conversation counts. Every text matters. Let’s get out the vote - together!

events.title: Canvass with SURJ in Western North Carolina!
events.description:
Come take action with SURJ and Down Home North Carolina!
The stage for the midterm elections is set, and the stakes for our movement and democracy couldn't be higher.

Join SURJ in doing our part to help flip the House and Senate and block MAGA while sending a crop of true movement champions to Congress. In North Carolina, we will be hitting the doors for House candidate Jamie Ager (NC-11) and NC Supreme Court Justice Anita Earls.

All canvasses will include a comprehensive training. No previous canvassing experience necessary!

- **North Carolina Congressional District 11** *(Block the Right Race)* - **Jamie Ager**, who is a fourth generation Western NC farmer. Running on making healthcare accessible, lowering costs, stopping government waste and corruption, and getting necessary relief to Hurricane Helene survivors.

**North Carolina Statewide** *Build Race- Movement Champion*- **Anita Earls** is an associate NC Justice running for re-election. On the NC Supreme Court, Earls has championed healthcare access, education, and protecting the right to vote. Earls is a critical line of defense to protect and re-institute fair maps for NC voters.

Logistics:
These canvasses will take place in-person with our movement partner, Down Home North Carolina. You will receive an email with orientation materials and meet-up location information ahead of time.

Feeling Unsure?
Our model works - learn from the best! Our relational conversation model works— SURJ phonebanks have one of the highest rates of success in the country. No matter whether you're brand new canvasser or a seasoned organizer, if you join our banks, you can trust that you are putting your effort into a method that works. And you'll get to learn powerful organizing skills from seasoned leaders!

Our conversations are based on open-ended questions and deep listening. You do not need to be an expert on the issues or a candidate - our canvasses are successful because we deeply connect with voters and make them feel heard.

Context:
As Trump and Republicans defund the social safety net and peddle more racist lies, millions of people are increasingly feeling the effects of the billionaire agenda. We know this fight is on multiple fronts, and this fall we have an opportunity to harness the energy of the streets and rising resentment towards November’s elections – to not only wrest power from MAGA, but to put candidates in office who are willing to stand up to Trump and fight for working class people. BOTH the House AND Senate are in play for Democrats to take back control and this year we aim to put progressive working class champions in a position to WIN.

This year is an opportunity to deliver strategic blows to the MAGA agenda and throw down a gauntlet to force the Democratic Party to reckon with true progressive, working class fighters.

To do this, we are protecting or flipping key Senate seats in North Carolina, Georgia, Maine and Mississippi and flipping critical house seats in North Carolina 11, Michigan 7, Tennessee 9 and California 22.

These races will affect millions of working class people this year. Riding the high from many wins for progressive champions throughout primary season, we are well positioned to send some of these same folks to the halls of Congress. We will continue to build power to stop MAGA, by supporting unapologetically progressive working class champions, while showing up in key races to block MAGA and showing up in solidarity alongside Black racial justice leaders in the south who are fighting back and beginning the long-build back from the gutting of the VRA. Alongside our partners across the country, this is the time for our movements to offer a bold vision and bring our people into it.

About SURJ:
Showing Up for Racial Justice (SURJ) is the largest organization in the country that explicitly organizes white communities for justice. Instead of choosing racism, silence, or complicity, we help white communities choose justice. We have thousands of national members and 150+ chapters across the US and Canada.

events.title: Blockwalk for Johnny Garcia
events.description:
## Ready to turn the tide in CD35?

Join Johnny and the team as we knock on doors in Bexar County to ensure everyone gets to the polls in November!

### What to Expect
This blockwalk is for anyone who is interested in having conversations with voters.

#### Everyone is welcome!
New volunteers will get plenty of support to get up to speed alongside experienced volunteers. 

### Event Schedule & Flow
To ensure a smooth and high-impact event, we ask all volunteers to arrive by 5pm.  

[5pm-5:30pm]: On-site orientation where we will review the program and do a quick refresher on miniVAN.

[5:30pm-7pm]: We will knock doors individually or in pairs. Experienced blockwalkers will pair up with less experienced ones to make sure everyone is comfortable using MiniVAN

[7pm-7:30pm]: Debrief and pack up. We will review the day's numbers, talk about what went well and what we can improve, and celebrate our success!

We're writing letters to reach potential voters before the elections. Register now, it takes 2 days to get approved, and we don't want you to miss being with us! We'll write, chat, and of course (always) have some singing. Can't write letters this time? Join anyway for some uplift, connection, and strength to help us all keep doing our best to make good trouble and big noise. 

RSVP here, and invite your friends too! Vote Forward is making a difference with their pioneering and innovative program using letters so volunteers like us can help turn out voters. 

Never written letters before? Go to votefwd.org and make an account; download twenty letters; and we’ll show you how to write them at our event!

Letters to underrepresented voters are a fun, easy, and highly effective way to strengthening our democracy by encouraging citizens from underrepresented communities to vote. Looking forward to seeing you!

events.title: Canvass with SURJ in Chatham County, NC!
events.description:
Come take action with SURJ and Down Home North Carolina!
The stage for the midterm elections is set, and the stakes for our movement and democracy couldn't be higher.

Join SURJ in doing our part to help flip the House and Senate and block MAGA while sending a crop of true movement champions to Congress. In North Carolina, we will be hitting the doors for NC Senate Candidate Roy Cooper)and NC Supreme Court Justice Anita Earls.

All canvasses will include a comprehensive training. No previous canvassing experience necessary!

-**North Carolina Senate** *(Block the Right Race)* **Roy Cooper** is a former Governor committed to affordability, education, and lowering healthcare costs. As governor, expanded Medicaid for North Carolinians. Deep MAGA opponent.

**North Carolina Statewide** *Build Race- Movement Champion*- **Anita Earls** is an associate NC Justice running for re-election. On the NC Supreme Court, Earls has championed healthcare access, education, and protecting the right to vote. Earls is a critical line of defense to protect and re-institute fair maps for NC voters.

Logistics:
These canvasses will take place in-person with our movement partner, Down Home North Carolina. You will receive an email with orientation materials and meet-up location information ahead of time.

Feeling Unsure?
Our model works - learn from the best! Our relational conversation model works— SURJ phonebanks have one of the highest rates of success in the country. No matter whether you're brand new canvasser or a seasoned organizer, if you join our banks, you can trust that you are putting your effort into a method that works. And you'll get to learn powerful organizing skills from seasoned leaders!

Our conversations are based on open-ended questions and deep listening. You do not need to be an expert on the issues or a candidate - our canvasses are successful because we deeply connect with voters and make them feel heard.

Context:
As Trump and Republicans defund the social safety net and peddle more racist lies, millions of people are increasingly feeling the effects of the billionaire agenda. We know this fight is on multiple fronts, and this fall we have an opportunity to harness the energy of the streets and rising resentment towards November’s elections – to not only wrest power from MAGA, but to put candidates in office who are willing to stand up to Trump and fight for working class people. BOTH the House AND Senate are in play for Democrats to take back control and this year we aim to put progressive working class champions in a position to WIN.

This year is an opportunity to deliver strategic blows to the MAGA agenda and throw down a gauntlet to force the Democratic Party to reckon with true progressive, working class fighters.

To do this, we are protecting or flipping key Senate seats in North Carolina, Georgia, Maine and Mississippi and flipping critical house seats in North Carolina 11, Michigan 7, Tennessee 9 and California 22.

These races will affect millions of working class people this year. Riding the high from many wins for progressive champions throughout primary season, we are well positioned to send some of these same folks to the halls of Congress. We will continue to build power to stop MAGA, by supporting unapologetically progressive working class champions, while showing up in key races to block MAGA and showing up in solidarity alongside Black racial justice leaders in the south who are fighting back and beginning the long-build back from the gutting of the VRA. Alongside our partners across the country, this is the time for our movements to offer a bold vision and bring our people into it.

About SURJ:
Showing Up for Racial Justice (SURJ) is the largest organization in the country that explicitly organizes white communities for justice. Instead of choosing racism, silence, or complicity, we help white communities choose justice. We have thousands of national members and 150+ chapters across the US and Canada.

events.title: Knock on doors with Ground Truth in Whitefield, NH!
events.description:
Join Swing Left for a Ground Truth canvass—designed to help Democrats flip Congress in 2026, and rebuild trust for the long term. For this year, we launched an [innovative new program](https://swingleft.org/ground-truth) that will revolutionize how we connect with voters and potential voters at their doors.

At this canvass, we’ll:

- **Listen deeply** to voters’ concerns, regardless of party affiliation.

- **Persuade voters** using a data-proven approach of exchanging personal stories and making the case for how electing Democrats connects to what they care most about.

- **Gather actionable insights** for campaigns, so they can be responsive to voters’ needs and smarter with their messaging, targeting, and outreach.

Don’t worry if it’s your first time canvassing—training, materials, and support are all provided. Just bring comfortable shoes, a charged phone, and your passion for making a difference.

––

**About the program**

This isn’t traditional canvassing—it’s a whole new way of talking to voters. Together, we’ll gather authentic insights from communities, use cutting-edge tools to capture what we hear, and share it back with campaigns to strengthen their efforts.

- *Why we started early:* We launched a year ahead of the midterms to build power before campaigns were even off the ground.

- *How we’ll go big:* We’re going to a wide range of voters’ doors—not just likely Democrats—so every conversation starts to build a more complete picture of the electorate.

- *How we’ll go deep:* Canvassers practice empathetic listening and have real conversations that uncover voters’ “ground truth,” not just checking boxes on a script.

Paid for by Swing Left, Swingleft.org, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee.

events.title: Reach And Recharge Happy Hour 📱 🍻 ☕🗳️ (First round of Coffee on us! :)
events.description:
Reach & Recharge: GOTV Texting Party! 📱🗳️

Ready to do the work that actually works?

Hey y'all!

We've spent years building relationships with voters across Texas, and the last several months working our asses off to build our Reach networks.

Now it's time to put all that work to use!

Early voting begins October 19, and we're shifting gears from building our networks to making sure every voter we've connected with has a plan to vote.

Join Powered by People for a Reach & Recharge (R&R) Texting Party! We're getting volunteers together to hang out, grab a drink on us, and make sure the people we've worked so hard to connect with actually get out and vote.

Here's the Plan:

🍻 Grab a drink and meet the team! Hang out with fellow volunteers and get ready to do some good work.

📱 Put your Reach network to work! Text the voters in your network who haven't voted yet.

🗳️ Help your people make a plan to vote! Answer questions about early voting, polling locations, and anything else they might need to cast their ballot.

🤝 Get some help! Whether you're a Reach pro or need a refresher, our organizers will be there to help you get those texts out.

How to Prepare

Already have a Reach network? Great. Bring it!

Haven't texted your people yet? Even better. That's what we're here for.

What to bring:

A fully charged smartphone with Reach installed

Let's Finish What We Started!

We've put in too much work to let it go to waste now.

We aren't just collecting names or hoping people show up to vote. We're building relationships, following through, and making sure nobody falls through the cracks.

Every voter we contact is another opportunity to make a difference, and every conversation matters.

We've built the networks. Now let's put them to work!

Bring your phone, bring a fellow PxP friend, grab a drink, and let's get to work.

Every volunteer. Every network. Every voter.

¡Vamos con todo!

A fully charged smartphone with Reach installed

events.title: Hold the Line practice: what would your team do?
events.description:
Tactical decision games are a form of scenario-based training used by militaries, firefighters, healthcare workers, and others to build judgment fast. They help newer people see themselves as capable decision-makers.

Join this call to play a game set inside one of the Hold the Line scenarios. You'll be part of a small Hold the Line team facing one hard moment, and you'll decide what your team does next.

There are three rules to TDGs.

The first is "If you are in the room, you are in the game."

Please join from a place where you can fully participate with your camera and mic on, type in the chat, and see a screenshare.

You'll learn the other two rules on Wednesday.

events.title: Join Denise Powell, Senator Dunixi Guereca, and Young Democrats of Nebraska to Get Out the Vote!
events.description:
# Knock doors with Denise Powell, Senator Dunixi Guereca, and The Young Democrats of Nebraska!

Senator Dunixi Guereca is the proud son of two Mexican immigrants who came to the US in search of a better life. He has dedicated his career to empowering everyday working people and creating opportunities.
As the Executive Director of Stand for Schools, he works every day to make sure that Nebraska's public schools remain among the best in the country. Prior to that, Sen. Guereca was a union organizer for SEIU where he built power so that healthcare workers were given a fair wage, had the tools to keep themselves safe during the pandemic, and were able to care for our loved ones.

Denise Powell is a mom, small business owner, former corporate executive, public school champion, and healthcare advocate who knows that a strong work ethic and a love of family and community are the Nebraska way of life. She also knows the Good Life is getting harder to come by. After Trump’s election in 2016, she founded an organization that has supported hundreds of Nebraskans running for local office, protected our public schools and the families they serve, and helped stop extremists from passing abortion bans in the state.

The Nebraska Young Democrats is an organization proudly dedicated to cultivating future Democratic leaders, involvement, and policy.

Join us as we unite to get out the vote for Denise Powell!

## What to bring:

- Charged Phone
- Water
- A positive attitude!

## What we will do:

- Knock on our neighbors doors to help them make a plan to vote in the upcoming election!

events.title: 10/24 - Voter Mobilization @ "Let's Vote!" Blockparty with Gina Hinojosa

location.venue: Martin Luther King, Jr. Branch Library

events.description:
_⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTE: Powered by People is halting all voter registration activities at our events from October 5 (the Texas voter registration deadline) to Election Day. During these events we will be helping voters make a plan to vote and answer their questions ahead of this important election!_

### Ready to do the work that actually works?

In 2024, our face-to-face voter registration model achieved a massive 79% voter turnout among the Texans we registered. We aren't just hoping for change—we have the blueprint to create it.

Join Powered by People for a high-impact **Voter Mobilization** shift at ** "Let's Vote!" Blockparty with Gina Hinojosa**! We are showing up to talk to voters, spark meaningful conversations, and make sure every eligible Texan is ready to make their voice heard.

At this event, we will: 

- Engage directly with attendees
- Ask people if they are active and have a plan to vote
- Connect with voters using **Reach**, our relational organizing tool, so we can personally stay in touch with them all the way to Election Day

### Shift Schedule & Flow

To ensure a smooth and high-impact day, please plan to arrive early for our team huddle. Here is what to expect during your shift:

- **10:45-11:00am: Team Huddle** | Arrive early to grab your materials, meet the team, and align on our goals for the event.

- **11:00am-2:00pm Voter Mobilization** | The main event! We engage community members, check their voter status, add people to Reach, and immediately answer questions related to the upcoming election (poll locations, time, ballot, etc.)

- **2:00-2:15pm: Debrief** | We will reconvene, tally our total number of Reach adds, make sure all voters are texted and tagged, celebrate our wins, and talk about next steps.

### How to Prepare

Before you arrive, please make sure you attend our **[mandatory online volunteer training](https://www.mobilize.us/poweredxpeople/event/908390/)** on Zoom. This training will get you fully up to speed on the flow of our events and teach you exactly how to navigate the Reach app.

### What to Bring

To set yourself up for a successful shift, please bring the following items:

- Your fully charged smartphone with the Reach app already installed

- A water bottle to stay hydrated

- Comfortable walking shoes and weather-appropriate clothing

_Note: Literature, giveaways (when applicable), and training cheat sheets will be provided during the huddle_

Let's keep building our momentum across Texas. Sign up for a Powered by People voter mobilization shift today!

events.title: MSU Walkout to Freeze AI
events.description:
A tiny handful of tech billionaires are building AI that threatens **our jobs, our freedoms, and humanity itself.** They're using it to steal our work, wreck job prospects, pollute our air and water, and surveil and endanger all of us, and they're buying the politicians whose job is to keep them in check. We deserve elected leaders who will fight alongside us to regulate Big Tech and make sure ALL of us have a say and a stake in the future of AI, not just a handful of Silicon Valley execs. 

So **on October 20th**, on campuses and communities across the country, thousands of us are walking out to demand **an immediate freeze on new AI development**, until we the people secure **a say, a stake, and strong safeguards**.

Join us on our campus at 10am - we’ll gather with together with fellow students, professors, community members, partners, and allies, hear from some great speakers, and share testimony about how unregulated AI has impacted our lives, jobs, communities, and futures – and we’ll call for an immediate freeze on AI development now. 

Whether you're a neighbor worried about data center pollution, a student worried about job prospects, a parent concerned about kids' development and mental health, join us this Tuesday. Because Big Tech won't regulate themselves!

After our kickoff, we'll take action together, with a quick training from our partners, and then we'll go reach out to our neighbors - to connect the grassroots fight for real AI regulation to power at the ballot box. 

Bring your signs and your friends!

Because we are partnering with an active campaign, all schedule details and locations are subject to change until finalized by the campaign. We will send out confirmed logistics closer to the event date.*

⚠️ *Additionally, Powered by People is halting all voter registration activities at our events from October 5 (the Texas voter registration deadline) to Election Day. During these events we will be helping voters adding them to **Reach** for Election Reminders to make a plan to vote and answer their questions ahead of this important election!*

### Ready to do the work that actually works?

In 2024, our face-to-face voter registration model achieved a massive 79% voter turnout among the Texans we registered. We aren't just hoping for change—we have the blueprint to create it.

Join Powered by People for the **Talarico for Texas** rally at **the [Frazer Alumni Pavilion] in [LUBBOCK]**! We are showing up as volunteers to this event to fire up the rally attendees, spark personal conversations, and build lasting progressive power through relational organizing.

At this event, we will: 

- Engage directly with passionate rally attendees and community members
- Check voter registration statuses on the spot (ensuring no one has been purged)
- Connect with voters using **Reach**, our relational organizing tool, so we can personally stay in touch with them all the way to Election Day

### Shift Schedule & Flow

To ensure a smooth and high-impact event, we ask all volunteers to arrive **1 hour before doors open** so that we can optimize working the line of attendees. They will be lining up way in advance, and our goal is to check voter registrations for everyone waiting to get in. Here is what to expect during your shift:

[5:00pm-6:00pm]: Setup & Team Huddle | **Arrive early** to grab your materials, meet the site leads, and align on our goals

[6:00-7:00pm] Working the Line (Part 1) | As the crowd grows ahead of doors opening, we will start engaging the very first people in line and continue moving down the line to check registration statuses and get folks set up on Reach.

[7:00pm]: Venue Mobilization | Once doors open, we continue to work the line and shift to the venue to catch any remaining attendees and trickling community members before the main programming starts.

[7:00-8:00pm]: Stay for the event! | Once the programming begins, volunteers are invited and encouraged to stay, enjoy the rally, and celebrate the energy with our neighbors!

[8:00-9:00pm]: Working the Line (Part 2) | After the event, we'll sweep the line of attendees waiting to take a photo with James Talarico


### How to Prepare

Before you arrive, please make sure you attend our **[mandatory online volunteer training](https://www.mobilize.us/poweredxpeople/event/908390/)** on Zoom. This training will get you fully up to speed on the flow of our events and teach you exactly how to navigate the Reach app.

**Please wear your PxP Tour Crew T-Shirts**

- **Meeting Location**: Frazer Alumni Pavilion on the Campus of Texas Tech.  Located between the West entrance of the Jones (aka Galaxy) Football stadium, there is a large bricked entry point out in front. It is also north of Dan Law Baseball Field on the same road. The C1 parking lot is across from the entrance. 

2680 Drive of Champions, Lubbock, TX 79409

- **Volunteer Parking**: Numerous off-campus lots nearby and bus routes with this location as a stop. 

### What to Bring

To set yourself up for a successful shift, please bring the following items:

- Your fully charged smartphone with the Reach app already installed

- A water bottle to stay hydrated

- Comfortable shoes (you will be on your feet talking to voters!)

events.title: Naples- Día de los Muertos Day of Action - End the ICE Age Rally and Donation Drive
events.description:
This Día de los Muertos, join **Indivisible Gambit SWFL** to honor and remember the lives taken by ICE and Border Patrol — and to demand an end to the violence.

Whether on the streets or inside one of the agency's more than 200 abuse-ridden detention facilities, ICE is tearing families apart, killing people, and threatening community safety nationwide. This Día de los Muertos, we're turning our grief and anger into action.

We'll gather and grieve publicly for the people who have died in ICE custody and been killed by ICE and Border Patrol agents, drawing on the Día de los Muertos tradition of honoring loved ones.

This action is part of End the ICE Age, a national day of action happening in cities across the country October 31–November 2. We're demanding Congress get ICE out of our communities, redirect ICE funding, and shut down ICE detention centers for good.

**When:** Sunday Nov. 1, 2026 5:00pm

**Where:** Collier County Courthouse Steps

**How to Prepare:** Bring anti-ICE signs, LED Candles, Plenty of water, Wear fun custumes and face paintings.

**Donation Drive** Please consider a donation to benefit Eva's Closet. We are collecting children's pajamas,  socks, and undergarments.

A core principle behind all Disappeared In America events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values and to act lawfully at these events. Weapons of any kind, including those legally permitted, should not be brought to events.

events.title: 11/1 WFP Canvass with Kelabe Tewolde, Jaelynn Scott, and Pramila Jayapal
events.description:
We're knocking doors with our endorsed candidates in Washington's 37th legislative district and 7th Congressional district! Ballots are due November 3rd- help us get the word out to our neighbors about these incredible working peoples' champions!

Location: Powell Barnett Park

Kelabe Tewolde (LD37 - House Seat 1) is a child of refugees who advocates to stop redlining and environmental racism on the Seattle Planning Commission and an educator who mentors and uplifts youth of color with Rainier Scholars, and is challenging a 27-year-incumbent who has voted to increase rents and lower taxes on corporations. Kelabe, in contrast, is by community and for community.

Jaelynn Scott (LD37 - House Seat 2) is a Black trans activist and proud socialist who serves as Executive Director of the Lavender Rights Project, a national black trans feminist advocacy organization advancing justice for gender diverse communities. She has spent years working in community, organizing, responding to crisis calls, helping people find sanctuary, and trying to help folks navigate the confusing, frustrating, broken system of social services.

We are thrilled to have our congressional champion representative Pramila Jayapal join us for this important GOTV day of action.  Representative Jayapal has not just stood up for the working people of WA but traveled the country and worked diligently for progressives and gone above and beyond to stand shoulder to shoulder with the WFP. 

If it’s your first time, no worries! Each session starts with a brief training & Q&A. Don't be afraid to reach out with questions!

events.title: Knock on doors with Ground Truth in [Harrisburg, PA] (PA-10)!
events.description:
Join Swing Left for a Ground Truth canvass—designed to help Democrats flip Congress in 2026, and rebuild trust for the long term. For this year, we launched an [innovative new program](https://swingleft.org/ground-truth) that will revolutionize how we connect with voters and potential voters at their doors.

At this canvass, we’ll:

- **Listen deeply** to voters’ concerns, regardless of party affiliation.

- **Persuade voters** using a data-proven approach of exchanging personal stories and making the case for how electing Democrats connects to what they care most about.

- **Gather actionable insights** for campaigns, so they can be responsive to voters’ needs and smarter with their messaging, targeting, and outreach.

- **Offer vote swapping** to voters still uncomfortable voting Democrat - giving them the opportunity to lodge a protest vote in MA-1, in exchange for voting Democrat in PA-10!

Don’t worry if it’s your first time canvassing—training, materials, and support are all provided. Just bring comfortable shoes, a charged phone, and your passion for making a difference.

––

**About the program**

This isn’t traditional canvassing—it’s a whole new way of talking to voters. Together, we’ll gather authentic insights from communities, use cutting-edge tools to capture what we hear, and share it back with campaigns to strengthen their efforts.

- *Why we started early:* We launched a year ahead of the midterms to build power before campaigns were even off the ground.

- *How we’ll go big:* We’re going to a wide range of voters’ doors—not just likely Democrats—so every conversation starts to build a more complete picture of the electorate.

- *How we’ll go deep:* Canvassers practice empathetic listening and have real conversations that uncover voters’ “ground truth,” not just checking boxes on a script.

Paid for by Swing Left, Swingleft.org, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee.

events.title: Vote Yes on the War Powers Resolution
events.description:
✊Vote Yes on the War Powers Resolution

Dear friends,

I am one of the millions of Americans who believes that only Congress has the power to declare war—and that no President, Democrat or Republican, should be able to drag our country into a costly, unauthorized conflict without a vote. Right now, Congress has a historic opportunity to reassert its constitutional authority and end an unauthorized war. But we need to make sure our representatives finish the job.

🚨 Our Constitution Is in Danger!

Here's what's happening:

•	On February 28, 2026, the Trump administration launched Operation Epic Fury, a major military campaign against Iran—without congressional authorization
•	The war has cost billions of taxpayer dollars, driven gas prices up 69% in some states, and put our brave servicemembers in harm's way 
•	The House has passed a War Powers Resolution three times—but it has never reached the President's desk 
•	The Senate passed a companion resolution 50–48 on June 24, 2026—the first time both chambers passed a war powers resolution since 1973 
•	But the White House is ignoring it, claiming the War Powers Act is "not constitutional" and "not binding" 
•	Congress has still not held public hearings or voted on a formal Authorization for Use of Military Force (AUMF)

Our Constitution is not optional. Our votes are not a suggestion. Congress must act.

📢 "Vote Yes on the War Powers Resolution" – That's Our Message

We are saying YES to:

•	✅ YES to the Constitution – Article I gives Congress, not the President, the sole power to declare war 
•	✅ YES to accountability – The American people deserve a vote before our troops are sent into harm's way
•	✅ YES to ending an unauthorized war – The War Powers Resolution of 1973 requires the President to withdraw forces within 60 days unless Congress authorizes the action
•	✅ YES to diplomacy – The administration launched this war while negotiations with Iran were actively ongoing 
•	✅ YES to our troops – They deserve clear objectives, an exit strategy, and the full support of a Congress that has debated and authorized their mission

Our Constitution is not a suggestion. Our votes are not optional. Congress must act NOW.

The American people deserve a vote. Our troops deserve a strategy. Our Constitution demands accountability.

Please act now. Our democracy depends on it.

events.title: Knock on doors with Ground Truth in Camp Hill, PA (PA-10)!

location.venue: entrance to Mount Calvary Episcopal Church

events.description:
Join Swing Left for a Ground Truth canvass—designed to help Democrats flip Congress in 2026, and rebuild trust for the long term. For this year, we launched an [innovative new program](https://swingleft.org/ground-truth) that will revolutionize how we connect with voters and potential voters at their doors.

At this canvass, we’ll:

- **Listen deeply** to voters’ concerns, regardless of party affiliation.

- **Persuade voters** using a data-proven approach of exchanging personal stories and making the case for how electing Democrats connects to what they care most about.

- **Gather actionable insights** for campaigns, so they can be responsive to voters’ needs and smarter with their messaging, targeting, and outreach.

- **Offer vote swapping** to voters still uncomfortable voting Democrat - giving them the opportunity to lodge a protest vote in MA-1, in exchange for voting Democrat in PA-10!

Don’t worry if it’s your first time canvassing—training, materials, and support are all provided. Just bring comfortable shoes, a charged phone, and your passion for making a difference.

––

**About the program**

This isn’t traditional canvassing—it’s a whole new way of talking to voters. Together, we’ll gather authentic insights from communities, use cutting-edge tools to capture what we hear, and share it back with campaigns to strengthen their efforts.

- *Why we started early:* We launched a year ahead of the midterms to build power before campaigns were even off the ground.

- *How we’ll go big:* We’re going to a wide range of voters’ doors—not just likely Democrats—so every conversation starts to build a more complete picture of the electorate.

- *How we’ll go deep:* Canvassers practice empathetic listening and have real conversations that uncover voters’ “ground truth,” not just checking boxes on a script.

Paid for by Swing Left, Swingleft.org, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee.

events.title: Kickback and Conversation with Sen. Rev. Raphael Warnock & Donavan McKinney | Black Voters for Abdul
events.description:
Please join Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock and Donavan McKinney at Bert's! Black Voters for Abdul and the R&P Vibe Band will be hosting a kickback and conversation. There will be food and music provided. 

Detroit, MI. 

U.S. Senate Candidate Abdul El-Sayed's Transforming Housing, Resources, Infrastructure, Value & Economic Opportunities (THRIVE) Policy Agenda, outlines the legislation he will introduce or support in the U.S. Senate to directly address the priorities of Black communities across Michigan.

Black communities across Michigan have too often been an afterthought in federal policy with promised investment that arrives late, falls short, or comes with no way to measure whether it actually made a difference. Abdul’s THRIVE Agenda sets a different standard: real accountability and measurable results.

Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock grew up in Kayton Homes public housing in Savannah, born one of twelve brothers and sisters raised in coastal Georgia. His father, a veteran, small businessman, and preacher, grew up in Burke and Screven County, GA. Senator Reverend Warnock’s mother grew up in Waycross, GA, where she spent summers picking tobacco and cotton. A graduate of Savannah’s Sol C. Johnson High School, Senator Raphael Warnock’s mother and extended family still lives in the Savannah area. 

Senator Warnock is a proud graduate of Morehouse College; after graduating from Morehouse, he went onto earn a PhD and begin his career ordained in the ministry. For over 15 years, Senator Warnock has served as Senior Pastor at Ebenezer Baptist Church in Atlanta, the former pulpit of Reverend Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. He is the youngest pastor selected to serve in that leadership role at the historic church.

Please note: the following items are not permitted inside the venue: No signs and no flags of any kind. No weapons of any kind, including for attendees with conceal carry permits. events.title: Stop the Michigan City Google Data Center Takeover Protest
events.description:
Join us this Tuesday! At the last Michigan City Common Council meeting, just a few weeks after the indefinite tabling of a moratorium introduced by Councilors Nelson and Moldenhauer, Councilors Kora and Dabney introduced a new data center moratorium that would effectively exempt the Google Project Maize Data Center and all phases at 402 Royal Road. 

Help us come together ahead of this Tuesday's, October 20th, council meeting to tell the Council we oppose this moratorium in its current form and ask them to strike subsection (d)(4) in its entirety, which effectively exempts Google and all future phases of their data center.

We need a moratorium that actually protects our Michigan City communities, NOT Big Tech!

Schedule: 
- Protest outside City Hall: 5:30-6:30 PM 
- Council meeting: Beginning at 6:30 PM

RSVP today to join us, and bring a neighbor and a friend.

See the moratorium ordinance and council agenda here: https://michigancityin.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/October-20-2026-Council-Agenda-w_Attach-1.pdf.

events.title: OSU Black Girls Vote Party At The Polls!
events.description:
# **LET’S PARTY AT THE POLLS!** 🗳️

*Celebrate our community. Cast your vote.*

We’re turning the ballot box into a block party! Come for the community, stay for the fun, and let’s make our voices heard together. It’s time to celebrate our power and show up for the neighborhood we love.

Join OSU Black Girls Vote for a celebration of civic power, music, and community spirit!

**THE VIBE:**

We’re bringing the energy to the ballot box! Whether you’re voting early or on Election Day, come hang out, meet your neighbors, and celebrate democracy in action.

**WHERE & WHEN:**

📍OSU Dorms 

📅 11-3-2026 at 5:00 pm to 8:00 pm

**FEATURING:**

A community-wide watch party where students can gather to vote together, monitor election results, enjoy food, and celebrate civic participation. 

**LET’S VOTE TOGETHER!** 

Bring a friend, meet the community, and let’s make it count.

**Any food, entertainment, buttons, stickers, or any other free items at this event are available to voters and non-voters alike. This is a nonpartisan event.**

events.title: 10/22 - Voter Mobilization @ Galveston County Talarico Rally [OUTDOOR]

address_lines: This event’s address is private. Sign up for more details
location.venue: This event’s address is private. Sign up for more details

events.description:
_⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTE: This is a volunteer signup page for Powered by People's voter mobilization team. Signing up here will register you as a volunteer to work the event, not as a general attendee for the rally itself. Because we are partnering with an active campaign, all schedule details and locations are subject to change until finalized by the campaign. We will send out confirmed logistics closer to the event date._

### Ready to do the work that actually works?

In 2024, our face-to-face voter registration model achieved a massive 79% voter turnout among the Texans we registered. We aren't just hoping for change—we have the blueprint to create it.

Join Powered by People for the **Talarico for Texas** rally at **the [Galveston Railroad Museum]**! We are showing up as volunteers to this event to fire up the rally attendees, spark personal conversations, and build lasting progressive power through relational organizing.

At this event, we will: 

- Engage directly with passionate rally attendees and community members
- Check voter registration statuses on the spot (ensuring no one has been purged)
- Connect with voters using **Reach**, our relational organizing tool, so we can personally stay in touch with them all the way to Election Day

### Shift Schedule & Flow

To ensure a smooth and high-impact event, we ask all volunteers to arrive **1 hour before doors open** so that we can optimize working the line of attendees. They will be lining up way in advance, and our goal is to check voter registrations for everyone waiting to get in. Here is what to expect during your shift:

[5:00-6:00pm]: Setup & Team Huddle | Arrive early to grab your materials, meet the site leads, and align on our goals.

[6:00-7:00pm] Working the Line (Part 1) | As the crowd grows ahead of doors opening, we will start engaging the very first people in line and continue moving down the line to check registration statuses and get folks set up on Reach.

[7:00-8:00pm]: Stay for the event! | Once the programming begins, volunteers are invited and encouraged to stay, enjoy the rally, and celebrate the energy with our neighbors!

[9:00-9:00pm]: Working the Line (Part 2) | After the event, we'll sweep the line of attendees waiting to take a photo with James Talarico


### How to Prepare

Before you arrive, please make sure you attend our **[mandatory online volunteer training](https://www.mobilize.us/poweredxpeople/event/908390/)** on Zoom. This training will get you fully up to speed on the flow of our events and teach you exactly how to navigate the Reach app.

### Where to Meet & Park

- **Meeting Location**: Galveston Railroad Museum

2602 Santa Fe Pl, Galveston, TX 75550

- **Volunteer Parking**: Parking is $5 in the museum parking lot

### What to Bring

To set yourself up for a successful shift, please bring the following items:

- Your fully charged smartphone with the Reach app already installed

- A water bottle to stay hydrated

- Comfortable shoes (you will be on your feet talking to voters!)

_Note: Necessary materials will be provided at the check-in table, but feel free to bring your own backup supplies just in case!_

Let's keep building on our momentum and ensure every single Texan counts. Sign up for a shift today!

address_lines: Cottage Grove Road & Royster Oaks Drive

events.description:
Early voting is crucial in the 2026 midterm elections to protect our democracy. We need to get our votes in early so nothing-neither the flu nor anti-democratic shenanigans-can prevent us from voting!

What scares you about the potential election results? 
Share your fears in sign messaging and costumes. Let’s have fun during this spooky season and frightening time in our country. Costumes are optional, but here are some ideas:

COSTUME/DRAWING/PROP: grim reaper and scythe
MESSAGE: Slashing (healthcare/SNAP/environmental protections) is terrifying!
Hurry to the polls!! VOTE EARLY!!

COSTUME/DRAWING/PROP: Grotesque pumpkins 
MESSAGE: Small/swing state/Wisconsin margins are scary!

COSTUME/DRAWING/PROP: Skeletons
MESSAGE: Healthcare cuts chill me to the bone!

COSTUME/DRAWING/PROP: Dracula
MESSAGE: Grocery prices/gas prices vant to suck my paycheck.

COSTUME/DRAWING/PROP: Bats
MESSAGE: election deniers are batty!

Need more ideas? Think about what pains you right now and what scares you about the future. Look up your ballot (https://myvote.wi.gov/) and check out the platforms. What’s the worst that could happen if we don’t show up and Tom Tiffany becomes governor? Look up and down the ballot. Review the referendums. How would the unfavorable outcomes change our lives in Wisconsin?

Join us near early voting polling place Pinney Library October 24 any time between 9:30 and noon to get the attention of passersby and drive traffic to the polls. We will line Cottage Grove Road with signs and enthusiasm and strongly welcome families to show up with us! 
Stop by for 15 minutes, an hour, or stay for the whole time!

We’ll provide:
Sidewalk chalk, bubbles (and rumor has it–candy!)
Posters with one blank side and the other with a fill-in-the-blank message, “I’m voting early for ______.”
Sharpies, duct tape

Feel free to bring: 
Noisemakers, water bottles, snacks, sticks to tape to posters
Scary costumes, images (see ideas for messaging)

Did you know?
Less than 1% of Wisconsin voters made the difference in re-electing the current president. He won by 29,417 votes. 

Dane County Democracy Tour
Indivisible Madison East is one of many Indivisible chapters and other progressive organizations in Dane County reaching out to our communities October 24 taking action with the Dane County Democracy Tour. Collectively, we will take actions to encourage our neighbors to vote early and canvass for candidates that will fight for the people.

events.title: Friday Morning Protest in Mentor - Pop-Up Block Party for Democracy [MENTOR]
events.description:
Friday, October 23, 2026 10:00 am – 12:00 pm :: Eleanor B Garfield Park - 7967 Mentor Ave, Mentor, OH 44060


What is a Pop-Up Block Party for Democracy?

We’re bringing art supplies, good company, and a little civic spirit to parks, coffee houses, libraries, and other public gathering places around town. Drop in for a few minutes or stay the whole time.

Keep it as simple or as hands-on as you like. You can sit down and make something with us, grab a kit to work on at home, or take a finished piece to keep, give to a friend, or leave somewhere in your neighborhood for someone else to find. If you’d rather just hang out and chat, that’s great too. No art skills needed.


Activities change from pop-up to pop-up. Here are some you might find:

Flock to the Polls: Crafty birds carrying a message and a QR code that helps people get ready to vote.

Rock-ing the Vote: Painted rocks with messages about voting and democracy, made for hiding around town.

Make & Take Yard Signs: Signs like our Ready, Set VOTE! design, with a QR code neighbors can scan to check ID rules, find their polling place, and more.

Dogs for Democracy: A bandana or sandwich board sign for your dog, with your own message. Great for marches, rallies, or a walk around the block.

Next 2sday Whistles: Decorative ICE whistles you can wear like everyday jewelry, so one’s always on hand. They’re also great noisemakers at rallies.

The People’s Assembly: Make a collage about what democracy means to you. It joins a larger community art piece we’ll display in the future.

Plus other hands-on projects, depending on the day.


Defending our democracy is hard work, especially right now. Making something together is one way to find a spark of hope, and have some fun along the way. Come join us!

events.title: Reach And Recharge Happy Hour at Merit Coffee (first coffee on us!)
events.description:
Reach & Recharge: GOTV Texting Party! 📱🗳️

Ready to do the work that actually works?

Hey y'all!

We've spent years building relationships with voters across Texas, and the last several months working our asses off to build our Reach networks.

Now it's time to put all that work to use!

Early voting begins October 19, and we're shifting gears from building our networks to making sure every voter we've connected with has a plan to vote.

Join Powered by People for a Reach & Recharge (R&R) Texting Party! We're getting volunteers together to hang out, grab a drink on us, and make sure the people we've worked so hard to connect with actually get out and vote.

Here's the Plan:

🍻 Grab a drink and meet the team! Hang out with fellow volunteers and get ready to do some good work.

📱 Put your Reach network to work! Text the voters in your network who haven't voted yet.

🗳️ Help your people make a plan to vote! Answer questions about early voting, polling locations, and anything else they might need to cast their ballot.

🤝 Get some help! Whether you're a Reach pro or need a refresher, our organizers will be there to help you get those texts out.

How to Prepare

Already have a Reach network? Great. Bring it!

Haven't texted your people yet? Even better. That's what we're here for.

What to bring:

A fully charged smartphone with Reach installed

Let's Finish What We Started!

We've put in too much work to let it go to waste now.

We aren't just collecting names or hoping people show up to vote. We're building relationships, following through, and making sure nobody falls through the cracks.

Every voter we contact is another opportunity to make a difference, and every conversation matters.

We've built the networks. Now let's put them to work!

Bring your phone, bring a fellow PxP friend, grab a drink, and let's get to work.

Every volunteer. Every network. Every voter.

¡Vamos con todo!

events.title: 10/31 Stand up for Democracy at Tesla, Lyndhurst
events.description:
There are only three political positions in America today:

1) I like the fascism

2) I'll acquiesce to the fascism (reasons for this one vary: money, cowardice, access, denial, Fox News, etc)

3) I oppose the fascism

The rest is details.

If you are in group 3, join us every Saturday from 11 AM - 1:00 PM in front of Tesla Motors, Lyndhurst, OH.

Rules & Reminders: Gather in front of Tesla Motors, 5180 Mayfield Rd, Lyndhurst, OH. Do not park in their lot or engage with their employees and customers. Bring a sign, flag and friends, we have extras if you need them. Stay on the sidewalk & allow pedestrians to pass, Do not jaywalk across Mayfield Road (police will be watching), Use the crosswalk just west of Tesla, Don't block driveway entrances or exits, Don't harass Tesla customers or employees, Do not argue with counter protesters, PROTEST PEACEFULLY. Watch for peacekeepers in yellow vests and immediately report any disturbances to them. Follow any instructions from Lyndhurst Police.

Parking is available at Messiah Lutheran Church, 5200 Mayfield Road. Please be respectful and park on the EAST SIDE of the lot first (away from the Tesla Store). Additional parking is available at the Lyndhurst Community of Faith Church, 5312 Mayfield Road. Please enter the EAST DRIVEWAY as the west driveway is exit only. Local street parking is also just a short stroll away.

The stakes couldn’t be higher. No one is coming to save us. Not politicians, not the media, not the courts.

Indivisable is a peaceful protest movement. We oppose violence, vandalism and destruction of property. This protest is a lawful exercise of our First Amendment right to peaceful assembly.

A core principle behind all Indivisable events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.

events.description:
In America, most people believe that voters should pick our leaders, not the other way around. But right now, people in power are trying to keep us from voting so they can control our elections and seize more power for themselves.

But we won’t let them decide our future or define what democracy looks like for our communities. From August to October, GenVote and our allies are embarking on a first-of-its-kind national tour, *Power Back: A Movement School for Election Defense*.

Join us at Michigan State University for the eleventh stop of the tour!

This tour stop is being organized in collaboration with local and statewide partners, including *Common Cause Michigan*.

Together, we'll get trained on:

- Election Protection 101

- Know Your Rights

- Creative Action Planning For Post-Election Scenarios

- Election Defense Lessons From Youth Movements Around the World


**This tour stop is free and open to community members of all ages**, with a special focus on students and young people. **Light refreshments and lunch will be provided.**

events.title: Freedom Summer Justice Revival - Memphis, TN
events.description:
## Justice Revival - Memphis, TN

Meet us in Memphis, TN for The Justice Revival.

**The Church is the Engine**

Freedom Summer is a steady drumbeat of mass mobilizations and events nationwide, each with a centerpoint city and coordinated satellite activations across the country. From Juneteenth Week to Election Day — these events are designed to keep pressure on, shift the conversation, and turn out our communities. We are unstoppable.

From Juneteenth through the midterms, we're gathering Black churches and people of faith into one sustained season of prayer, fasting, revival, and organized action.

We'll begin with 16 days of fasting and devotion from Juneteenth to the Fourth of July, grounding people spiritually each day as we prepare for the work ahead. From there, daily prayer calls, Justice Revivals, and The Freedom School gatherings in churches and communities across the country will carry the work through the summer and into the fall.

### Event Details

**Wednesday, October 28th, 2026**

**6:30 PM**

**New Direction Church**

**6120 Winchester Rd, Memphis, TN*

Register to reserve your seat.
